statement: Two records sharing an identifier is an error; neither MUST be treated as the referent.
note: Both records carry `dec-7f3a91`. The duplication MUST be reported, and the citation MUST resolve to NEITHER record -- not to the first ingested, not to the most recently written, not to the one whose title is closer to anything.
